page.layout: Top: printed page number "236" centred at the head, then an ornamental woodcut border. Full-width title block in large Fraktur and roman type, centred: a division heading "APPENDIX:" followed by the Fraktur title, then the address block in capitals and small capitals with the salutation below. Below that, one column of running text with a large initial H and a catchword at the right foot.

main_text.head: APPENDIX:
Darinnen/ auß vielen etlich wenige Keyf. Maj. Maximi-liani I. Mußifen/ und Caroli V. Diploma, oder Bestallungs und Schutzbrieff/ an H. Wil. Pirckf. sampt etlichen andern/ begriffen.
Auß welchen zuvernemmen/ inn was Auctoritet/ Würden und Ansehen er bey höchstgedachte ihren Majestäten: Auch was für ein besonder Liebhaber und Beförderer aller guten und löblichen Künste er gewesen.
HONORABILI, FIDELI, NOBIS DILECTO, BILIBALDO PYRCKAMAYR, Consiliario nostro.

p.i: Maximilianus, Divina favente clementia, &c. Roman. Imperator, semper augustus, &c.

main_text.p: HOnorabilis, fidelis, dilecte: Dum hiis superioribus temporibus honorabilis Ioan-

page.notes: The title block is set in mixed Fraktur and roman type; the Fraktur words are transcribed as closely as the scan allows. Long s is shown as ß where the printer used the ss ligature (Mußifen, Auß), which is the German convention and not a long-s character. "Mußifen" is uncertain: the scan may read "Mussifen" or "Mussifen" [?]. The head "etlich" is set with a printer's hyphen in the scan ("ec=lich"), which is not clearly legible. The catchword "nes" sits at the right foot, below the last line, and is not repeated in the text. No running head is printed on this page.
